summary: Design-only acceptance/contract for Research OS Migration Phase 1: a future repository-resolution layer, automation/acceptance/external-repo-resolution.yaml, that removes the current hard assumption -- REPO = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[2] in scripts/automation/scan_artifacts.py and scripts/automation/update_dashboard.py -- that Research OS automation and experiment evidence must live in the same Git repository. This follows the accepted architecture recommendation from this session's read-only migration audit: research-os becomes the governance/dashboard/automation repository; wifi-csi-fall-attack-safety-demo remains the experiment-and-evidence repository; evidence is never copied into research-os. Defines: (1) a two-layer configuration model -- a tracked, portable automation/registry/external_repositories.yaml registry (schema_version, repository_id, repository_role, expected_remote_url, canonical_branch_or_ref_policy, provenance_commit_policy, required_repository_relative_paths, allowed_evidence_roots, read_only_to_research_os, git_identity_verification_required, dirty_worktree_policy, claim_boundaries -- explicitly containing no absolute local path or credential) plus a gitignored, machine-local automation/local/external_repository_paths.yaml override (repository_id -> absolute checkout path only, never committed, never appearing in a receipt, with a committed no-user-path example template and a defined fail-visibly behavior when missing -- explicitly forbidding any sibling-folder inference); (2) a future shared resolver module's nine responsibilities: distinct governance-repo vs. external-repo resolution paths, (repository_id, repository_relative_path) pair resolution, no sibling-folder inference, full identity verification (existence, Git-worktree validity, exact remote-URL match, required-path presence, full 40-char commit SHA, dirty-worktree policy) before any read, path-traversal/absolute-path/symlink-escape rejection via realpath resolution against an explicit allowed_evidence_roots allowlist, strict read-only operation, a prohibition on fetch/clone/checkout/pull/reset/merge/push against any external repository, zero network access, and visible (never silent) failure on nine named error conditions; (3) a commit-and-provenance policy distinguishing three identities -- Research OS governance-repository commit, external experiment-repository commit, and historical (pre-migration) receipt git.head fields -- with an explicit rule that historical 7-character-hash receipts are NEVER reinterpreted, rewritten, or backfilled, while any NEW cross-repository claim must record full 40-character SHAs for both; (4) a path-migration policy replacing bare legacy path strings with explicit (repository_id, repository_relative_path) pairs, including a bounded legacy-compatibility mode (valid only while exactly one experiment repository_id is configured, failing visibly rather than guessing if more than one is ever configured) with a documented removal condition and stale/unresolved-path reporting requirements; (5) a future-changes-only inventory covering scan_artifacts.py, result_explorer.py, update_dashboard.py, every path/evidence validator, artifact-manifest handling, experiment identity, reference evidence, frontier.yaml, candidate-review inputs, receipt creation/verification, dashboard status generation, and every test currently assuming one repository root -- none modified by this contract; (6) safety requirements identical in spirit to every prior read-only checker in this repo (no experiment execution, no held-out-test access beyond existing permitted metadata/path checks, no test-split-guard weakening, no experiment_queue.yaml or protocol-freeze modification, no execution authorization, no evidence copying, no second source of truth, no network access, no writes to an external repository); (7) implementation acceptance criteria requiring full backward compatibility in same-repository (legacy) mode, synthetic-temporary-Git-repository tests only (no network, never against real wifi-csi-fall-attack-safety-demo or research-os checkouts), explicit rejection tests for remote-URL mismatch/missing override/path traversal/symlink escape, full-40-char-SHA capture, byte-unchanged external-repo contents after every test, and preserved idempotency/deterministic rendering; (8) an explicit future-migration boundary stating this task does not migrate, delete, or relocate any Research OS file, does not create the resolver/registry/override file/migration branch/research-os file/migration commit/queue entry/pilot proposal/experiment, and that VALIDATION-PILOT-GATE implementation remains paused until the (separately, later approved) actual migration is validated. YAML re-parsed successfully via yaml.safe_load (21 top-level keys). No resolver module, tracked registry file, local-path override file, or test was created. automation/registry/experiment_candidates.yaml, automation/reviews/next_experiment_review.yaml, automation/experiment_queue.yaml, every acceptance contract other than this new file, every protocol-freeze record, and every test-split-guard file remain byte-unchanged -- confirmed via git diff --stat showing zero output against the full protected-file list. No Research OS file was moved, copied, or deleted; no migration branch or research-os file was created; no experiment, queue action, protocol change, or held-out-test read occurred.
